segments.an6.49:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.an6.49:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā ca khemo āyasmā ca sumano sāvatthiyaṃ viharanti andhavanasmiṃ.
segments.an6.49:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā ca khemo āyasmā ca sumano yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā khemo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an6.49:2.1: “Yo so, bhante, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññā vimutto tassa na evaṃ hoti –
segments.an6.49:2.2: ‘atthi me seyyoti vā atthi me sadisoti vā atthi me hīnoti vā’”ti.
segments.an6.49:2.5: Atha kho āyasmā khemo “samanuñño me satthā”ti uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
segments.an6.49:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā sumano acirapakkante āyasmante kheme bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an6.49:3.2: “yo so, bhante, bhikkhu arahaṃ khīṇāsavo vusitavā katakaraṇīyo ohitabhāro anuppattasadattho parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojano sammadaññā vimutto tassa na evaṃ hoti –
segments.an6.49:3.3: ‘natthi me seyyoti vā natthi me sadisoti vā natthi me hīnoti vā’”ti.
segments.an6.49:3.6: Atha kho āyasmā sumano “samanuñño me satthā”ti uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
segments.an6.49:4.1: Atha kho bhagavā acirapakkantesu āyasmante ca kheme āyasmante ca sumane bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.an6.49:4.3: Attho ca vutto attā ca anupanīto.
segments.an6.49:4.4: Atha ca pana idhekacce moghapurisā hasamānakā [hasamānakaṃ (ka.) mahāva.245] maññe aññaṃ byākaronti.

lines: Anuppattasadatthoti sadattho vuccati arahattaṃ, taṃ pattoti attho.
Sammadaññā vimuttoti sammā hetunā kāraṇena jānitvā vimutto.
Tassa na evaṃ hoti atthi me seyyoti vātiādīhi seyyassa seyyohamasmīti mānādayo tayo mānā paṭikkhittā.
Na hi khīṇāsavassa “atthi mayhaṃ seyyo, atthi sadiso, atthi hīno”ti māno hoti.
Na hi khīṇāsavassa “ahameva seyyo, ahaṃ sadiso, ahaṃ hīno, aññe seyyādayo natthī”ti evaṃ māno hoti.
Hasamānakā maññe aññaṃ byākarontīti hasamānā viya kathenti.
Na ussesu na omesu, samatte nopanīyareti ettha ussāti ussitatā seyyapuggalā.
Iti imesu tīsupi seyyahīnasadisesu khīṇāsavā mānena na upanīyare, na upanenti, na upagacchantīti attho.

lines: Taṃ pana yasmā catūhi maggehi paccekaṃ catūsu saccesu kattabbattā soḷasavidhaṃ veditabbaṃ.
Khandhakilesaabhisaṅkhārasaṅkhātā tayo osīdāpanaṭṭhena bhārā viyāti bhārā.
Te ohitā oropitā nikkhittā pātitā etenāti ohitabhāro.
Ettha hi arahattaṃ attano yonisomanasikārāyattattā attūpanibandhaṭṭhena sasantānapariyāpannattā attānaṃ avijahanaṭṭhena attano uttamatthena ca attano atthattā “sakattho”ti vuccati.
Sammadaññā vimuttoti sammā aññāya vimutto, acchinnabhūtāya maggapaññāya sammā yathābhūtaṃ dukkhādīsu yo yathā jānitabbo, tathā jānitvā vimuttoti attho.
Vimuttoti ca dve vimuttiyo sabbassa cittasaṃkilesassa maggo nibbānādhimutti ca.
